data.title: Bitcoin holds up better than Ethereum, XRP, and... | Pluang
data.description: Following the Binance hack, Bitcoin, Ethereum, XRP, and BNB all saw increased volatility with varying declines. Bitcoin showed resilience, dropping only 6.5% from its recent high and maintaining support around $76,000. BNB fell 14%, impacted by its Binance association but still stronger than Ethereum and XRP, which dropped 20.6% and 23% respectively, both falling below key support levels. The market now watches if these assets can regain lost ground amid ongoing uncertainty.
data.author: Cointribune
